description: Agent Uncertainty: submit an agent’s answers against its own confidence threshold: optionally the policy with the confidence below which the agent declines or defers in percent and whether that threshold is written where the principal can read it; and each question with its id, the question as asked, the confidence the agent held in percent, what it did (answered, declined or deferred), its reply as given, read for guess wording such as my best guess or off the top of my head, why it declined or deferred as told to the principal, and what would resolve the question as named, such as the signed contract or the Q4 figures. The signed report gives the policy, every question with its status as answered, abstained, answered_below_threshold, guessed, unexplained, unresolved, abstained_above_threshold or unconfirmed, and counts the answers, declines, deferrals and questions below the threshold, and names an agent that guesses where it should abstain: questions answered below its stated threshold, and answers whose own wording calls them a guess; then declines or deferrals that give no reason, declines or deferrals that name nothing that would resolve them, questions declined at or above the threshold and a threshold never written down, with the fix for each. This reads one agent’s discipline in declining below its own threshold: when an operator’s escalation policy fires is wever_escalation-threshold-check, and how a group of agents escalates a disagreement is wever_coordination-escalation-check. Verdict abstention_undisciplined, abstention_gaps, abstention_unverified or abstention_disciplined. POST /api/uncertainty-abstention-check. Reads only the recorded work product and records in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write; no answer is changed, no source is fetched and no party is contacted. Agent Uncertainty reads the uncertainty an agent carries in its own work products and answers, its stated confidence, what it does not know and what it assumed: it is not formal scoring of outputs against rubrics, datasets and benchmarks (the wever_evaluation checks), not grading the source material itself (wever_claim-evidence-check, wever_data-evidence-check and the other evidence checks), not traces, metrics and runtime behavior (the wever_observability checks) and not the loop around feedback received (the wever_feedback checks). Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-uncertainty-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-uncertainty/.

answers.description: Each question with what the agent did.

confidence.description: The confidence the agent held, in percent.

id.description: The question id, such as q1.

reason.description: Why the agent declined or deferred, as told to the principal.

resolves.description: What would resolve it, as named, such as the signed contract.

text.description: The reply as given, read for guess wording such as my best guess.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

stated.description: The threshold is written where the principal can read it.

threshold.description: The confidence below which the agent declines or defers, in percent.

name: wever_uncertainty-abstention-check
